history.summary: UNCERTAIN IDENTITY — the CSV entry 'Maruti Temple, Belgaum' is a generic name with no documented single referent. This record documents the most likely candidate: the Shri Maruti (Hanumantha) Temple at Maruti Galli, Raviwar Peth, Belagavi old city (~1 km from Belagavi railway station; listed hours 5 AM-10 PM; reviewers note 'many different avatars of Lord Hanuman'). A stronger alternative referent is the Mal Maruti Mandir (Shree Mala Maruthi Devasthana) in the Mal Maruti Extension/Mahantesh Nagar area, one of Belagavi's most famous Hanuman shrines (reviewers claim an 1854 founding or 200+ years of history, with a swayambhu idol on a hillock); other Maruti shrines exist on Kapileshwar Road and Ganeshpur Road. Identity should be confirmed against the CSV's intended referent.

name: Shri Maruti (Hanumantha) Temple
town_description: Belagavi (Belgaum) is a major city in northwestern Karnataka near the Maharashtra and Goa borders, known for the historic Belgaum Fort, the 1204 Kamala Basti, and its colleges; it sits on an important road and rail link between Mumbai and Bengaluru.
